question: Ticket fc3859155412 says 'reseals green on Windows — the verdict proof should pass and seal on Windows', but outline 9.4.8.1 reads "The verdict's instrument run is a seal-grade run, so it runs where the sealer runs (9.4.2.3.3.1), under bubblewrap. A box without bubblewrap (Windows) asks for it and does not run it itself. A bwrap-only tooth reads not-run on such a box, never red; its outcome is the sealer's. - CC" (Outline 9.4.8.1 states: 'A box without bubblewrap (Windows) asks for it and does not run it itself. A bwrap-only tooth reads not-run on such a box, never red; its outcome is the sealer's.' The outline's intention is that verdict instrument runs do not complete on Windows boxes; they ask the sealer (which runs elsewhere) to do it. Which stands, the ticket or the outline?
why_it_blocks: the ticket and the component outline disagree; building it would build one of them wrong
